Our SEO content writing service plans and writes service pages, location pages and blog posts for businesses in Edmonton, Alberta, built on your team's expertise and fact-checked by people, as part of our {{Edmonton SEO services|}}.

sections.heading: What SEO content writing is
body: **SEO content writing means planning and writing pages around the questions customers actually search, then making each page the most useful answer available.** It is the content side of search engine optimization (SEO): people-first content written for your customers and structured so Google can understand it.
We interview you, turn your expertise into plain language and write content that sounds like your business. Before you commission anything, list the ten questions customers ask you most on the phone.

sections.heading: SEO content we write for Edmonton businesses
sections.intro: **Our SEO content writing covers six page types, each matched to a stage of the customer's search.** Service pages win ready-to-buy searches; blog posts and guides win the research that comes first.

items.title: Service pages
items.text: One detailed page for each service you offer, matched to how customers search for it, with prices and process where you publish them.

items.title: Location pages
items.text: Pages for the towns you really serve, each with unique local detail, so they never read as copies with the name swapped.

items.title: Blog posts and guides
items.text: In-depth answers to the questions customers research, each linking to the service page, so blog readers become leads.

items.title: FAQ content
items.text: Short, direct answers to common questions, placed on the pages where customers ask them.

items.title: Content refreshes
items.text: Older pages updated so facts, prices and screenshots stay accurate.

items.title: Content strategy

sections.heading: What Google says helpful SEO content looks like
body: **Google describes helpful SEO content as people-first: easy to read, well organized, unique, up to date and written for the reader rather than for rankings.** Its {{guide to helpful content|https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content}} explains E-E-A-T: experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trustworthiness, with trust the most important.
That is why we write content from your expertise, cite sources and show who wrote and reviewed each page. Ask your team who can review pages in their field before the first one is drafted.

sections.heading: Location pages that rank without becoming doorway pages
body: **Location pages that rank give each town unique, useful detail; pages that only swap the town name are doorway pages, which Google's {{spam policies|https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies}} treat as spam.** Google lists pages targeted at specific regions or cities that funnel users to one page as doorway abuse.

So we write a location page only where you really serve customers and have something local to say, such as travel times, local permits or the jobs you do there. Pick the two towns where you can say the most.

items: Do you use AI to write content?

No, people write every page. Writers may use tools for research, but every page is planned, written, edited and fact-checked by a person, because Google's spam policies cover scaled, low-value content however it is made.
How many pages per month can you write?
The number of pages per month is [[pages per month and turnaround per page]]. It depends on page length, how much research each topic needs and how quickly your team reviews drafts.
Can you write location pages without them being doorway pages?
Yes. Each location page needs unique, useful detail about that town and a real reason for the customer to be there, and we do not write one where you have nothing local to say.
You do. Nothing is published without your sign-off, and you can request changes at the brief and draft stages.
Can you write for regulated industries?

Yes, with review from your qualified team before publishing. Our {{law firm SEO|industries/law-firms}}, {{immigration lawyer SEO|industries/immigration-lawyers}} and {{med spa SEO|industries/med-spas}} pages show the rules each field follows.
How do you measure content success?
We measure each page by its rankings, organic traffic and the enquiries it drives, reported per piece. A {{free SEO audit|free-seo-audit}} shows which pages your site is missing today.

items: Does Shopify handle SEO for me?

No, only part of it. {{Shopify|https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/promoting-marketing/seo/find-site-map}} generates a sitemap.xml file automatically and its themes include structured data, but your categories, product copy, duplicate URLs and Merchant Center data still need work.
Should I optimize category or product pages first?
Category pages usually come first in our page strategy, because they rank for broader searches and link to every product in them. Product pages follow, starting with your best sellers.

Google Merchant Center is a free Google tool where you upload and manage product data so your products can show across Google, including Search, Maps and YouTube. Product structured data on your site and your Merchant Center feed should show the same prices and stock.

sections.h1: AI Search Optimization for Edmonton Businesses
sections.lead: AI search optimization gets your content ready to be found and cited in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. We do it for businesses in Edmonton, Alberta as part of our {{Edmonton SEO services|}}, starting from what Google itself says.

sections.heading: What AI search optimization and GEO mean
body: **AI search optimization is the work that makes your content easy for AI features and AI assistants to find, understand and cite.** Generative engine optimization (GEO) is another name for it, taken from a 2023 research paper, {{GEO, Generative Engine Optimization|https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735}}. Some agencies sell the same work as AI SEO services.
Whatever the name, the base is search engine optimization (SEO): pages that are indexed, crawlable and answer questions clearly. Check that your key pages are indexed in Search Console first.
bullets: Accurate Business Profile and structured data

sections.heading: How AI search finds local businesses
body: **AI search finds local businesses through the same public information Google Search uses: your website, your Business Profile and your Google reviews.** When someone asks an AI assistant for a furnace company in Edmonton, the answer draws on sources it can find and trust.

That makes clear entities (your business name, services, areas and credentials stated the same way everywhere) and consistent reviews part of AI search readiness. Make sure your Business Profile matches your website before anything else.

sections.heading: What Google says about AI features and AI search optimization
body: **Google says there are no additional requirements or special optimizations needed to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode; a page must be indexed and eligible to show in Search with a snippet.** Its page on {{AI features and your website|https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features}} lists the usual best practices: allow crawling, use internal links and keep important content in text.

It also says no special schema.org markup or AI text files are needed, and recommends keeping your Business Profile and Merchant Center information up to date. Our post on {{what Google says about AI Overviews|blog/ai-overviews-and-your-website}} explains each point.

items: Do I need special optimization for AI Overviews?
No. Google says there are no additional requirements or special optimizations needed to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode, so the work is doing the SEO fundamentals very well.
No, mostly not. Generative engine optimization uses the same base as SEO, crawlable and indexed pages with clear answers, and adds checks on whether AI answers cite you.
Can you get my business mentioned in ChatGPT?

No one can guarantee it, but you can make it possible. {{OpenAI|https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots}} says sites that block its OAI-SearchBot crawler will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers, so we check your robots.txt allows it and keep your content clear and accurate.
Can you guarantee we appear in AI Overviews?
No. Google says indexing and serving are not guaranteed, even when a page meets every requirement.
Do we need an llms.txt file?
No, not for Google. Google says AI text files are not needed for its AI features; llms.txt is a proposed convention that some other tools read, so we add one only if you want it.
